objective: Generate musically compelling, controllable music through focused experiment labs sharing one Rust composition algebra, a composable musical ontology and contextual harmonic relationships.

checkpoint.summary: CompositionPlan retains generic untimed value trees, explicit timed patterns and authored voices. Degree nesting carries no durations; separate duration trees determine time. Explicit step counts bound the simple editor's independent degree, duration, sound-mask and native-offset cycles. Shared references, nested expansion, variadic combination, temporal subdivision, overlap and clipping lower through the existing compiler. Time, slot and sounding-attack clocks remain explicit. Degree coordinates map once through arbitrary lattices before native offsets; harmonic member anchors and voice identities remain separate. Serialized shared/local edits and authored scene edits regenerate dependent notes. Patterns & voices provides compact recursive editors and live passage/solo updates; invalid drafts retain the last valid music and stale worker results cannot replace newer edits. Harmonic Motion retains contextual chord routes, exact member correspondence and bounded phrase-continuity preferences. These are executable authored relationships, not inferred melodic hierarchy or a universal melody-quality model.
nextActions: Audition complete phrases and their individual lines under matched harmonic constraints and explicit zero-continuity controls. Evaluate contour, motives, duration, inter-line motion, harmonic exposure and phrase destination separately; keep the chromatic descent and already-stepwise diminished controls.

Use shared pattern programs to compare recognizable outer shapes, inner figures, independent rhythmic development and harmonic-member edits in complete passages. Evaluate perceptual quality separately from exact rendering and relation reuse; do not equate smoothness or concise construction with a strong melody.
If adding expectation, use a declared style/input tier and independent listener or repertoire evidence with work-lineage holdouts; hand-set costs remain compositional preferences.

Connect tuning and spectral premises only through a concrete compositional experiment. Preserve exact source coordinates and declare native rounding; roughness, functional stability and musical quality remain separate.

Keep future experiments isolated, retain the ontology's qualified vocabulary and lower useful relationships through CompositionPlan. Artist references guide musical goals, never hard-coded identities or fixed phrase lengths.
